## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change that solves it.

## Privacy and security

- [ ] File contents remain browser-local and are not persisted or sent over the network.
- [ ] New DOM sinks, storage, network access, dependencies, or CSP changes are documented and tested.
- [ ] Fixtures contain only fictional data.

## Accessibility and testing

- [ ] Keyboard and focus behavior was checked where relevant.
- [ ] `npm run format:check`, `npm run lint`, and `npm run typecheck` pass.
- [ ] `npm test` and `npm run build` pass.
- [ ] Relevant Playwright tests were added or run.

## Screenshots

Include before/after screenshots only when the visible interface changes.
